RESOLVED: Dear Dana Whitfield,

Thank you for reaching out regarding the denial of your MRI claim (CLM-550193). 

"Prior authorization not on file" means that the specific procedure required approval from Meridian Health Plan before it was performed. Because this was not obtained, the claim was denied.

You have the right to appeal this decision. According to our policy (KB-2207), you have 180 days from the date of your denial notice to file a first-level appeal. Additionally, your doctor can submit a "retrospective authorization request" along with clinical documentation supporting the medical necessity of the MRI for your migraines, which may resolve the issue without a formal appeal.

I have attached the appeal form (FORM-APP-1) to this message for your convenience. If you choose to appeal, please ensure it is submitted within the 180-day window. Standard appeals are typically processed within 30 calendar days.

As requested, I have also synchronized your member record with our internal systems to ensure your file is up to date. Please let us know if you need further assistance.
